about_the_game:
Liminal Gas Station

A surreal horror visual novel set in a gas station that should not exist.
April works the night shift. You can talk to her. Sleep beside her. Maybe even love her. But the choice isn’t always yours—and the exits don’t always lead out.

ABOUT

The last thing you can remember was walking home from work, You are given the option to go into the Gas Station. The lights are on. The door’s unlocked. The shelves are stocked with nothing you recognize. April greets you, She is Surprised to see you.

She’s the only one here, and has been for a long time.

  • A dark visual novel with psychological horror, branching paths, and a tightly focused narrative, and multiple endings.

  • Explore a gas station locked in dream logic and liminal space, and how it continues to draw you in

  • Build trust—or tension—with April, a woman who may be a victims of the gas station or something else.

  • Multiple endings, Live or Die it's Up to you.

  • Sleep and dream together, but understand what it costs.

  • Inspired by, analog decay, and older pc games attempt at realism that can feel uncanny.

  • Rich atmosphere: VHS buzz, CRT TV, Scanlines, dead hallway hum, silence that watches.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains content intended for mature audiences, including:
Explicit sexual content and strong language
References to and depictions of drug use
Fetish themes and suggestive dialogue.
Bodily fluids and unsettling imagery.
Depictions of manipulation, and coercion.
Player discretion is strongly advised.

short_description: Trapped in a gas station that shouldn't exist, you're drawn into a surreal relationship with April, the night clerk. She may love you—or destroy you. A horror visual novel about control, intimacy, and impossible escape.
